{{Quote|I really must see about hiring your spies away from you. Especially after you stole my best horticulturist. A pity the man had that fatal lift accident before he could start working for you.|Emperor Palpatine, to Prince Xizor|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] employed a '''gardener''' to maintain the extensive botanical gardens on his [[Emperor's skyhook|personal skyhook]]. During a visit to the [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] was so impressed by the botanical display that he hired the [[Gender/Legends|man]] away from the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] to work on the gardens of his own skyhook [[Falleen's Fist]]. Never a good loser in even the most trivial of cases, Palpatine in response had the man [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] "accident", even though he had been his best [[horticulturist]].
